_comment: Ablation: separate per-domain encoders (E_MR + E_CT) instead of one shared E.
_purpose: Tests whether the shared encoder is responsible for cross-modal knowledge transfer.
With separate encoders, all alignment between MRI and CT must emerge from the
cycle-consistency loss alone — the segmentation decoder S cannot share representations
across domains because E_MR and E_CT are independent.
Expected outcome (hypothesis): separate encoders should produce lower MRI Dice
(seg_real_MR, the cross-modal proxy) than the shared-encoder baseline, confirming
that E is the mechanism for segmentation knowledge transfer.

_notes.SHARED_ENCODER: false = use E_MR for MRI inputs and E_CT for CT inputs. Both encoders have identical architecture but independent weights.
_notes.Other hyperparameters: Inherited from base_config.json by the training script's config-layering logic. Only keys present here override the base config.
